spec_family.name: New Construction Ceiling Paint - Pre-Trim
spec_family.description: Finish coat application for primed drywall ceilings in new construction. Assumes ceilings already primed. Applies 1-2 coats ceiling paint. No edge work required (walls painted after, wall painter establishes ceiling line). Includes protection of ceiling fixtures and window/door masking.

includes: Finish coat application (1-2 coats depending on QT)
Window/door masking - verify existing or apply if missing
excludes: Edge work at ceiling-wall boundary (wall painter establishes line)
Trim painting (pre-trim phase, no crown molding)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier governing prep intensity, material grade, and number of coats
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2-QT3 = single coat flat; QT4 = two coats (flat for colored ceilings OR eggshell/satin for sheen); QT5 = two coats semi-gloss+, critical prep and inspection

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish sheen level - affects application difficulty on ceilings
configuration_dimensions.notes: Flat is standard for ceilings. Higher sheens require progressively more careful application. QT4 can be flat (for color) or eggshell/satin. QT5 is semi-gloss+.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for ceiling paint
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray+backroll is NC production standard; roll for smaller jobs
Texture affects coverage rate and application technique

paintable_items.name: Ceiling Field Finish Coat
paintable_items.notes: Primary paintable item - ceiling finish paint application

protection_items.name: Ceiling Fixture Protection (Lights + Electrical)
protection_items.counting_rules: Source from PaintScope PS_META.EA.ROOMS_TOTAL; heuristic: 6 recessed lights + 2 ceiling electrical boxes per room
protection_items.notes: Stuff recessed cans and ceiling electrical boxes with paper, tape over face

protection_items.name: Window Opening Masking
protection_items.notes: Verify existing masking intact or apply new - overspray/splatter falls on windows

protection_items.name: Door Opening Masking
protection_items.notes: Verify existing masking intact or apply new - overspray/splatter falls on doors

variants.notes: Standard NC production - spray+backroll, single coat
Premium spray+backroll flat - two coats for colored ceilings or enhanced coverage. No sheen penalty.
Premium spray+backroll eggshell/satin - two coats with sheen. Sheen application penalty applies.
Critical spray+backroll for semi-gloss+ finish - two coats, critical prep and inspection. Significant sheen penalty.
Economy roller - single coat, window/door protection recommended
Premium roller flat - two coats for colored ceilings or enhanced coverage. No sheen penalty.
Premium roller eggshell/satin - two coats with sheen. Sheen application penalty applies.
Critical roller for semi-gloss+ finish - two coats, critical prep and inspection. Significant sheen penalty.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Floor area for subfloor vacuum cleanup
Room count for ceiling fixture protection heuristic
Count of window openings to verify/apply masking
Count of door openings to verify/apply masking

site_condition_rules.effect: Height modifier applies per production.json height_effects. Scaffold/lift setup adds fixed time.
site_condition_rules.notes: Ceilings above 14ft require scaffold or lift access, significantly impacting all overhead tasks

site_condition_rules.effect: Occupied spaces may restrict spray methods due to overspray and fumes. May force roll-only application.
site_condition_rules.notes: NC is typically unoccupied, but phased occupancy can occur in multi-unit projects

site_condition_rules.effect: Poor ventilation restricts spray methods and slows all work. May force roll-only application.
site_condition_rules.notes: Enclosed spaces without HVAC running require additional ventilation setup for spray work

valid_input_states.notes: Ceiling paint requires primed surface from ceiling prime spec

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen configuration

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Full mask required for finished walls — solid tape line at wall-to-ceiling junction with draped plastic along wall. Rare in NC (ceilings before walls) but required for repaint scenarios.
Unfinished walls need no protection — ceiling paint rollover is acceptable

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Ceilings painted BEFORE walls in NC production
sequencing_notes.edge_work: NONE REQUIRED - ceiling painter can roll onto wall area. Wall painter establishes final ceiling line.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Verify/apply masking → Protect ceiling fixtures → Apply finish coat(s) → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: QT4 only: Coat 1 → Light sand → Coat 2

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial spec for NC ceiling paint (finish coats). No edge work (wall painter establishes line). Window/door masking required for overspray/splatter protection.
